verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects documents custom fields, including single-select fields (e.g., Low/Medium/High priority) and iteration fields. It also offers built-in workflows that set field values automatically and is described as customizable to a team's processes. However, no evidence explicitly shows editing the workflow Status field's options or columns; docs-12 covers project-level status updates, which is a different feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of customizing workflow status values or columns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: You can use custom fields to add metadata to your issues, pull requests, and draft issues and build a richer view of item attributes.
A single select field to track whether a task is Low, Medium, or High priority.
Built-in workflows allow you to automatically set fields when items are added or changed
Rather than enforcing a specific methodology, a project provides flexible features you can customize to your team’s needs and processes.
